changelog: Image support for test questions: questions, options and solutions can now show figures. Tap a figure to view it fullscreen. Practice question sets are here: Practice tab now shows UPSI Reasoning chapter-wise sets from the book. Tap an option to see the answer and the book solution at once — no timer, no negative marking. Chapter-end summary shows correct, wrong and not attempted, and practice cards show Attempt, Result and Re-attempt like tests.
